note: Threads error -> what the app does. Data, not code: a Meta change edits this file. Meta publishes NO error-code table (2026-11-16); rows marked 'report' come from developers' first-hand reports and must be confirmed in the owner's real test. 'on': false rows are ignored until switched on.

codes.why: session key invalid: wrong Threads app id/secret pair or a re-exchanged token
application does not have permission for this action
permission error: threads_content_publish missing or lost
object does not exist: wrong Threads user id (use the id from /me)
media not found right after create (propagation race): re-read the container, resend once
media download failed: retry with a fresh file name
unknown error, a retry is suggested
account restricted: a person must look

names.name: THREADS_API__LINK_LIMIT_EXCEEDED
names.why: more than 5 links in the text

container_errors.name: FAILED_DOWNLOADING_VIDEO
container_errors.why: Threads could not download the video_url: the host must serve the file directly over https

container_errors.name: FAILED_PROCESSING_VIDEO
container_errors.why: Threads could not process the video

container_errors.name: FAILED_PROCESSING_AUDIO
container_errors.why: Threads could not process the audio

container_errors.name: INVALID_AUDIO_CHANNELS
container_errors.why: audio must be mono or stereo
